header_learn_more.desc_en: Intelligent automation systems for residential and commercial buildings. Control lighting, HVAC, security, and energy usage from a single unified platform.
header_learn_more.desc_id: Sistem otomasi cerdas untuk gedung residensial dan komersial. Kontrol pencahayaan, HVAC, keamanan, dan penggunaan energi dari satu platform terpadu.

header_learn_more.desc_en: End-to-end sensor networks for factories and warehouses. Real-time monitoring of production lines, predictive maintenance, and automated quality control.
header_learn_more.desc_id: Jaringan sensor end-to-end untuk pabrik dan gudang. Pemantauan lini produksi secara real-time, perawatan prediktif, dan kontrol kualitas otomatis.

header_learn_more.desc_en: Custom-built edge gateways that process data locally before sending to the cloud. Reduce latency, save bandwidth, and enable offline operation for mission-critical applications.
header_learn_more.desc_id: Gateway edge yang dibangun khusus untuk memproses data secara lokal sebelum dikirim ke cloud. Kurangi latensi, hemat bandwidth, dan aktifkan operasi offline untuk aplikasi mission-critical.

features.learn_more_desc_en: IoT connects devices, enabling automation, monitoring, and remote intelligence.
features.desc_id: Hubungkan dan kontrol perangkat melalui jaringan IoT untuk menciptakan lingkungan yang lebih cerdas.
features.desc_en: Connect and control devices through IoT networks to enable smarter environments.
features.learn_more_desc_id: IoT menghubungkan perangkat sehingga dapat melakukan otomatisasi, pemantauan, dan pengendalian jarak jauh.

benefits.desc_id: Pantau seluruh perangkat dan sensor secara langsung dari satu dashboard terpusat, kapan saja dan di mana saja.
benefits.desc_en: Monitor all devices and sensors live from a centralized dashboard, anytime and anywhere.

benefits.desc_id: Otomatisasi proses manual mengurangi biaya operasional hingga 40% dan meminimalkan human error.
benefits.desc_en: Automating manual processes reduces operational costs by up to 40% and minimizes human error.

benefits.desc_id: Arsitektur modular memungkinkan penambahan ratusan perangkat baru tanpa mengganggu sistem yang sudah berjalan.
benefits.desc_en: Modular architecture allows adding hundreds of new devices without disrupting existing systems.

benefits.desc_id: Enkripsi end-to-end dan protokol keamanan IoT terkini memastikan setiap data terlindungi.
benefits.desc_en: End-to-end encryption and the latest IoT security protocols ensure every piece of data is protected.

benefits.desc_id: Data dari sensor diolah menggunakan AI untuk memprediksi kebutuhan perawatan sebelum terjadi kerusakan.
benefits.desc_en: Sensor data is processed using AI to predict maintenance needs before failures occur.

benefits.desc_id: API terbuka dan protokol standar (MQTT, HTTP) memudahkan integrasi dengan sistem yang sudah ada.
benefits.desc_en: Open APIs and standard protocols (MQTT, HTTP) make it easy to integrate with existing systems.

header_learn_more.desc_en: Multi-modal biometric solutions including palm vein scanning, iris recognition, and fingerprint authentication — delivering the highest level of identity verification for critical facilities.
header_learn_more.desc_id: Solusi biometrik multi-modal meliputi pemindaian pembuluh darah telapak tangan, pengenalan iris, dan autentikasi sidik jari — memberikan tingkat tertinggi verifikasi identitas untuk fasilitas kritis.

header_learn_more.desc_en: AI-powered face recognition terminals with real-time identification, high accuracy in low-light conditions, and seamless integration with access control systems for offices, apartments, and commercial buildings.
header_learn_more.desc_id: Terminal pengenalan wajah bertenaga AI dengan identifikasi real-time, akurasi tinggi dalam kondisi cahaya rendah, dan integrasi mulus dengan sistem akses kontrol untuk perkantoran, apartemen, dan gedung komersial.

header_learn_more.desc_en: Intelligent access control systems powered by AI that combine face recognition, fingerprint, and card access in a unified platform. Includes AI parking systems with automatic license plate recognition and smart visitor management.
header_learn_more.desc_id: Sistem kontrol akses cerdas bertenaga AI yang menggabungkan pengenalan wajah, sidik jari, dan kartu akses dalam satu platform terpadu. Termasuk sistem parkir AI dengan pengenalan plat nomor otomatis dan manajemen pengunjung pintar.

features.learn_more_desc_en:
We develop artificial intelligence-based solutions designed to enhance security and operational efficiency across various sectors.

From face and iris recognition to palm vein authentication, our AI technology delivers the highest levels of accuracy and security for your facilities.

With cutting-edge deep learning algorithms and optimized hardware, we ensure every AI solution works in real-time with reliable performance.
features.desc_id: Solusi kecerdasan buatan canggih untuk keamanan biometrik, pengenalan wajah, dan otomatisasi cerdas.
features.learn_more_title_id: Teknologi AI untuk Keamanan dan Efisiensi
features.desc_en: Advanced artificial intelligence solutions for biometric security, face recognition, and intelligent automation.
features.learn_more_desc_id:
Kami mengembangkan solusi berbasis kecerdasan buatan yang dirancang untuk meningkatkan keamanan dan efisiensi operasional di berbagai sektor.

Dari pengenalan wajah dan iris mata hingga autentikasi pembuluh darah telapak tangan, teknologi AI kami memberikan tingkat akurasi dan keamanan tertinggi untuk fasilitas Anda.

Dengan algoritma deep learning terkini dan perangkat keras yang dioptimalkan, kami memastikan setiap solusi AI bekerja secara real-time dengan performa yang andal.

benefits.desc_id: Algoritma deep learning mencapai tingkat akurasi pengenalan biometrik di atas 99%, meminimalkan kesalahan identifikasi.
benefits.desc_en: Deep learning algorithms achieve biometric recognition accuracy above 99%, minimizing identification errors.

benefits.desc_id: Identifikasi dan autentikasi dilakukan dalam hitungan milidetik, memastikan pengalaman pengguna yang cepat dan seamless.
benefits.desc_en: Identification and authentication are performed in milliseconds, ensuring a fast and seamless user experience.

benefits.desc_id: Kombinasi beberapa metode biometrik (wajah, iris, sidik jari, telapak tangan) memberikan keamanan berlapis yang sulit ditembus.
benefits.desc_en: Combining multiple biometric methods (face, iris, fingerprint, palm vein) provides multi-layered security that is hard to breach.

benefits.desc_id: Model AI terus belajar dan beradaptasi terhadap perubahan kondisi lingkungan seperti pencahayaan, sudut, dan penampilan.
benefits.desc_en: AI models continuously learn and adapt to changing environmental conditions such as lighting, angles, and appearance.

benefits.desc_id: SDK dan API yang lengkap memudahkan integrasi dengan sistem yang sudah ada tanpa perombakan infrastruktur.
benefits.desc_en: Comprehensive SDKs and APIs make it easy to integrate with existing systems without infrastructure overhaul.

benefits.desc_id: Arsitektur yang dirancang untuk menangani ribuan pengguna secara bersamaan dengan uptime dan performa tinggi.
benefits.desc_en: Architecture designed to handle thousands of users simultaneously with high uptime and performance.

features.learn_more_title_en: AI Technology for Security and Efficiency
